title: Signed first-row cofactors as restricted Leibniz sums: (−1)^q·det(N_{t,q.succAbove s}) = Σ_{σ(0)=q} sgn σ·Π_t N_{t,σ(t.succ)} (parent Step 2)
statement: Let r ∈ ℕ, let N : Fin r → Fin (r+1) → ℝ be an arbitrary r×(r+1) real array (rows t ∈ Fin r, columns in Fin (r+1)), and let q ∈ Fin (r+1). Let q.succAbove : Fin r → Fin (r+1) be the increasing enumeration of Fin (r+1) ∖ {q}, let t.succ = t+1 ∈ Fin (r+1) for t ∈ Fin r, let 0 be the first element of Fin (r+1), and for a permutation σ of Fin (r+1) let sgn σ ∈ {1, −1} ⊂ ℝ be its sign. Put ε_q(σ) := sgn σ if σ(0) = q and ε_q(σ) := 0 otherwise. Then (−1)^q · det(N_{t, q.succAbove(s)})_{t,s ∈ Fin r} = Σ_{σ ∈ Perm(Fin (r+1))} ε_q(σ) · Π_{t ∈ Fin r} N_{t, σ(t.succ)} (for r = 0 the determinant is the empty determinant 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (r : ℕ) (N : Fin r → Fin (r + 1) → ℝ) (q : Fin (r + 1)), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (q : ℕ) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin r => N t (q.succAbove s)) = ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (r + 1)), (if σ 0 = q then ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℝ) else 0) * ∏ t : Fin r, N t (σ t.succ)
